mapper.textPrompt:
Convert this running workout description into intervals.icu workout text.

Rules:

- One step per line: "- ", then a duration, then a target. Example: - 35m Z3 Pace
- Durations: s = seconds, m = minutes, h = hours. Distances in metres use mtr, e.g. 400mtr.
- Targets are pace zones or percentages only, using the table below. A range is written Z2-Z3 Pace or 60-77% Pace.
- Repeats: a line "Nx" before the repeated steps, N denotes number of repeats, with one empty line before and after the block. No nested repeats.
- If the description has vague walking breaks as optional, leave them out.
- If you need to think, do it inside NOTES_START NOTES_END.
- Then write WORKOUT_START on its own line, the final workout exactly once, and WORKOUT_END on its own line. Nothing after WORKOUT_END.
- If the description can't be converted, write WORKOUT_START, then UNPARSEABLE, then WORKOUT_END.

Intensity key (TrainerRoad RPE → target):
- RPE 2 / very very easy / recovery: 60-77% Pace
- RPE 3 / very easy / endurance: 77-83% Pace
- RPE 4 / easy / endurance: 83-88% Pace
- RPE 5 / comfortable / marathon: 88-93% Pace
- RPE 6 / comfortably hard / half marathon: 93-97% Pace
- RPE 7 / hard / 10k: 97-100% Pace
- RPE 8 / very hard / 5k: Z5 Pace
- RPE 9 / very very hard / mile: Z6 Pace
- RPE 10 / maximal / sprints: Z7 Pace

- A recovery inside a repeat with no RPE given (e.g. "5min easy" after an interval): Z2
- A step with an effort word but no RPE number: match the word to the key above.

Example:
"Description: 10min Easy RPE4 (Endurance) pace to warm up

6x3min Very Hard RPE8 (5k) pace, 3min easy

9min Easy RPE4 (Endurance) pace to cool down"

Output:
WORKOUT_START
- 10m 83-88% Pace

6x
- 3m Z5 Pace
- 3m Z2 Pace

- 9m 83-88% Pace

WORKOUT_END

Now convert this workout:
Workout name: {{3.name}}
Description: {{3.description}}
